children.name: Cancer plebejus
children.description: Cancer plebejus is a species of crab in the genus Cancer.

children.name: Cancer bellianus
children.description: Cancer bellianus, the toothed rock crab, is a common species of crab in the north-eastern Atlantic Ocean.

children.name: Cancer pagurus
children.description: Cancer pagurus, commonly known as the edible crab or brown crab, is a species of crab found in the North Sea, North Atlantic Ocean, and perhaps the Mediterranean Sea.

children.name: Cancer productus
children.description: Cancer productus, one of several species known as red rock crabs, is a crab of the genus Cancer found on the western coast of North America.

children.name: Cancer irroratus
children.description: Cancer irroratus (Atlantic rock crab or peekytoe crab) is a crab in the genus Cancer.

children.name: Lobocarcinus sismondai
children.description: Lobocarcinus sismondai is an extinct species of marine crab in the family Cancridae.

children.name: Metacarcinus anthonyi
children.description: Metacarcinus anthonyi, the yellow rock crab or yellow crab, is a species of edible crab native to the Pacific coast of North America.

children.name: Metacarcinus edwardsii
children.description: Metacarcinus edwardsii, sometimes known as mola rock crab, southern rock crab, or Chilean rock crab, is a species of crab from the Pacific coast of South America.

children.name: Romaleon antennarium
children.description: Romaleon antennarium (formerly Cancer antennarius), commonly known as the Pacific, brown or California rock crab, is a crab of the genus Romaleon found on the western coast of North America.

children.name: Romaleon franciscae

children.name: Glebocarcinus oregonensis
children.description: Glebocarcinus oregonensis, commonly known as the pygmy rock crab, is a species of crab found on the Pacific coast of North America.
